quote.text: Believers, if a troublemaker brings you news, check it first, in case you wrong others unwittingly and later regret what you have done.

shots.framing: HOOK. Close-medium: hands grabbing the last water gallons off a small shop shelf at dawn
shots.vo_markup: By sunrise, the whole city *knew.*
shots.vo: By sunrise, the whole city knew.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: Several hands (sleeves, bracelets, a child's hand) yanking gallons and bottles off a nearly empty shelf; a gallon tips over
shots.notes: Frame 0 already chaotic and moving (twos). Shelf wobbles (ones). Gallon thud on "knew".

shots.framing: Wide: a shop rolling door rising at dawn, a queue already outside
shots.vo_markup: The only problem… none of it was *true.*
shots.vo: The only problem… none of it was true.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: Rolling door rattling up; a line of people with empty jerrycans; a woman hugging three bottles
shots.notes: Door finishes rising on "problem"; everyone turns at "true" (twos).

shots.framing: Medium two-shot at a small breakfast stall: a woman leans in and whispers into the stall owner's ear
shots.vo_markup: It started as one *whisper* at a food stall.
shots.vo: It started as one whisper at a food stall.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: Stall owner (40s, headscarf) frozen mid-ladle as a customer whispers; steam from the pot
shots.notes: Lean-in lands on "whisper".

shots.framing: Extreme close-up: lips near an ear (profile), headscarf edge
shots.vo_markup: The water is *poisoned.*
shots.vo: The water is poisoned.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: A mouth whispering into an ear; the listener's eye widens (only the eye corner visible)
shots.notes: Faces simplified; no detailed lips/teeth, stylised profile. Eye widens on "poisoned".

shots.framing: IMAGINED (rumour image): the neighbourhood water tower at night, a faceless silhouette standing at its foot
shots.vo_markup: Someone saw a *stranger* by the water tower last night.
shots.vo: Someone saw a stranger by the water tower last night.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: A tall faceless silhouette by the water tower, rendered as an unreliable rumour (desaturated, slightly grainy-looking flat tones, no detail)
shots.notes: This is what people IMAGINE, not what happened: keep it stylised, cold, flat. Silhouette fades in on "stranger".

shots.framing: Close: two passengers in an angkot, one leaning to the other's ear
shots.vo_markup: Nobody asked who saw him.
shots.vo: Nobody asked who saw him.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: Mouth-to-ear in the angkot, window light strobing
shots.notes: Chain of whispers part 1. Sway on ones; people on twos.

shots.framing: Close: men at a pos ronda (guard post) huddled, one whispering
shots.vo_markup: Nobody asked how they knew.
shots.vo: Nobody asked how they knew.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: Three men leaning in at the guard post; one cups a hand to whisper
shots.notes: Chain part 2.

shots.framing: Medium: the same shop shelves, now completely empty, a handwritten "HABIS" (sold out) card
shots.vo_markup: By seven, the shelves were *empty.*
shots.vo: By seven, the shelves were empty.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: Empty shelves; the stall owner standing behind them, arms crossed
shots.notes: Card can say "HABIS" (Indonesian for sold out). Dust motes in the light.

shots.framing: Medium: in front of a small house, a mother pours a bucket of water into the gutter; her small daughter with a doll watches from the doorstep
shots.vo_markup: Mothers poured water down the *drain.*
shots.vo: Mothers poured water down the drain.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: Mother tipping the bucket; water splashing into the gutter; daughter clutching a doll
shots.notes: Pour starts on "poured", splash on "drain".

shots.framing: Medium-wide: two old men (peci, sarong) arguing at the mosque gate; one jabs a finger
shots.vo_markup: Old men *argued* at the mosque gate.
shots.vo: Old men argued at the mosque gate.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: Two old men in heated argument; others watching from the side
shots.notes: Finger jab on "argued".

shots.framing: Fast montage inside one shot: mouth-to-ear passes in different places (school gate mothers, market sellers, a barber chair), each 0.5–0.7 s
shots.camera: Quick hard cuts inside the shot (allowed: hard cuts only)
shots.vo_markup: And the story grew with every mouth it passed through.
shots.vo: And the story grew with every mouth it passed through.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: A relay of whispers getting faster
shots.notes: Each pass is a new mini-composition; keep faces simple.

shots.framing: IMAGINED: the rumour image of the water tower again; the silhouette multiplies into three; then red lines/arrows of a "plan" appear around the tower like a crude conspiracy drawing
shots.vo_markup: One stranger became *three.* Poison became a *plan.*
shots.vo: One stranger became three. Poison became a plan.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: Three faceless silhouettes; crude red marker lines and arrows around the tower
shots.notes: Multiply exactly on "three"; red lines draw on "plan". Same stylised rumour look as shot 5.

shots.framing: Wide: a crowd turning into a narrow kampung alley, a man at the front pointing
shots.camera: Slow push forward behind the crowd
shots.vo_markup: By noon, they *found* him.
shots.vo: By noon, they found him.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: Crowd of 8–12 simplified figures, the leader pointing down the alley
shots.notes: Point on "found". Harsh noon light, short shadows.

shots.framing: Medium: a young man (20s, work T-shirt, tool bag) kneeling by a leaking pipe at the alley wall; he looks up
shots.vo_markup: A young man, new in the neighborhood.
shots.vo: A young man, new in the neighborhood.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: The young man looking up, wrench in hand, water dripping from the pipe
shots.notes: He looks up on "man".

shots.framing: Close: his hands tightening a pipe joint; the drip slows and stops
shots.vo_markup: He had been fixing a leaking pipe… for *free.*
shots.vo: He had been fixing a leaking pipe… for free.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: Hands with a wrench on a pipe joint; the last drop falls
shots.notes: Drip stops on "free".

shots.framing: Low angle from the young man's eye level: the crowd closing in around him, faces in shadow against the bright sky
shots.vo_markup: The crowd closed *in.*
shots.vo: The crowd closed in.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: A ring of dark silhouettes closing in
shots.notes: Crowd steps forward on "in" (twos).

shots.framing: Extreme close-up: a hand picking up a stone from the dirt
shots.vo_markup: Someone picked up a *stone.*
shots.vo: Someone picked up a stone.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: A hand closing around a stone
shots.notes: Grip on "stone". Then hold: tension.

shots.framing: Low angle: the mosque loudspeaker horns on a pole against the sky
shots.vo_markup: Then the mosque speaker *crackled.*
shots.vo: Then the mosque speaker crackled.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: The loudspeaker horns; a bird lifts off
shots.notes: Speaker "jolts" (tiny shake) on "crackled".

shots.framing: Medium: inside the mosque, the marbot (caretaker) reads a paper into a microphone; through the door, the crowd outside looks up
shots.vo_markup: The water had been tested. It was *clean.* It always had been.
shots.vo: The water had been tested. It was clean. It always had been.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: Marbot side view at the microphone with a paper (official stamp visible as a simple shape)
shots.notes: He lifts the paper on "tested"; crowd faces turn up on "clean".

shots.framing: Close: the hand opens and the stone drops into the dirt; feet turn away
shots.vo_markup: The crowd went *home.*
shots.vo: The crowd went home.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: The stone falling; feet walking off
shots.notes: Stone drops on "home".

shots.framing: Medium-wide: the young man alone in the alley picking up his scattered tools; the backs of the crowd leaving at the end of the alley
shots.vo_markup: No one said sorry. No one asked who started it.
shots.vo: No one said sorry. No one asked who started it.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: The young man kneeling, collecting tools
shots.notes: He stays (twos breathing); crowd backs recede.

shots.framing: Wide: the water tower at dusk, birds circling, the kampung roofs below
shots.vo_markup: The warning had been written long ago.
shots.vo: The warning had been written long ago.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: The real water tower at dusk (warm, NOT the rumour style)
shots.notes: QUOTE hovers over shots 22–23 (Qur'an 49:6). Keep the upper 40% of the frame calm/dark enough for the quote.

shots.framing: Medium: the stall owner pulling down her stall shutter at dusk, pausing, looking down
shots.vo_markup: And the Prophet said that repeating everything you hear is lie enough.
shots.vo: And the Prophet said that repeating everything you hear is lie enough.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: The stall owner pausing with her hand on the shutter, eyes down
shots.notes: She pauses on "Prophet"; shutter comes down on "enough". Keep the upper 40% calm for the quote.

shots.framing: Medium-wide: a dark terrace, two heads close together, one whispering; across the alley the lit window of the mosque
shots.vo_markup: That night, a new whisper began. This time, it named someone everyone *trusted.*
shots.vo: That night, a new whisper began. This time, it named someone everyone trusted.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: Two silhouettes on a terrace, one whispering, both turning to look toward the lit mosque window on "trusted"
shots.notes: Hard cut to black at the shot end.

shots.framing: TITLE CARD on black
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: "FASTER THAN THE TRUTH" + "CHAPTER 2 · THE LAST DAYS"
shots.notes: Same title design as EP01 shot 25 (copy from episodes/ep01/src/shots/P.tsx S25).
